cards.evidence_summary: Acute kidney injury was reported in 22 Bisoprolol-containing cases (2.15% of the analyzed cohort). 22 cases were classified as serious, including 1 death-associated case(s) and 15 hospitalization-associated case(s). The candidate is assigned higher_priority_candidate for review purposes only. This classification does not establish causality, incidence, disproportionality, or a confirmed safety signal.
cards.follow_up_recommendation: Prioritize for detailed case review, temporal assessment, clinical context review, confounder assessment, and external evidence evaluation.
